note: Wooded private campground with a general store and deli (closed in winter) directly across from the Cummins Falls State Park entrance north of Cookeville. Gravel RV sites, back-in and pull-through; bathhouse; no tent sites and no generators. Cottages and nearby homes also rent. A few designated extended-stay sites; stays over 14 days need approval. --Claude
summary: Old Mill Camp: operator home/about/regulations pages, Campspot API (Dec 2026 quotes), Google Maps, gateways.py, Esri. Price gate PASSES on a dated base: $44 back-in site charge (Dec 2026), $49 pull-through; Campspot one-night total $49.54 incl. park's $4 booking fee and 3.5% processing. Google 4.8 / 934. Long-stay: all 22 RV sites sell nightly on Campspot, 14-day limit, extended stays on designated sites only - passes. 50A/water/sewer on all sites, 65-150 ft. Cottages are a side line, not the main product.
flags: PRICE GATE PASS (dated): Campspot 2026-12-08 and 2026-12-12 one-night quotes give the back-in site charge $44.00 (pull-through $49.00), plus the park's own 'Booking Fees' $4.00 per stay and 'Processing Fee' 3.5%; one-night all-in before tax $49.54 (back-in) / $54.72 (pull-through). Cheapest real RV night $44 <= $50. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Nashville 110 km). 2027 is not yet loaded on Campspot - summer 2027 rate unread; operator page shows the same $44/$49 with '*special rates may apply during holidays'.
GOOGLE: 'Old Mill Camp at Cummins Falls State Park' 4.8 from 934 reviews - the listing covers the campground AND its general store/deli, so the rating is not the campground's alone.

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) recreational campground, 'not a residential community'; (2) nightly rate posted $44/$49; (3) Campspot books single nights; (4) all 22 Campspot RV sites (16 back-in, 6 pull-through) bookable nightly - 22/22 open on 2026-12-08, 10/22 open on 2026-12-01; (5) no lots sold. Extended stays only on 'designated' sites with approval. Passes; not mostly seasonal.
Cottages/homes: 2 cottages ($89, 2-night min) and off-site rental homes (~$120) - RV sites are the main product, not an afterthought. Cottage 2-night minimum is not the RV sites'.
